lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical stripes visible on the primary foreground subject. Spacing is broader on the posterior half and narrows progressively toward the anterior shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the third vertical stripe from the posterior, splitting as it approaches the dorsal line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The two most posterior 'stripes' are discontinuous, appearing as vertically oriented sequences of discrete circular spots rather than solid lines.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 6 to 8 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch and upper hind limb, posterior to the vertical stripe field.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the mid-haunch align horizontally to form a brief geometric segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron band on the bridge of the muzzle and two distinct white spots on the lower cheek. Dark horizontal pigment bands are visible above the hooves on the forelimbs.
